mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with supply chain growth
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window during easing cycles with INDPRO above 110.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of mid-cycle expansions with HOUST above 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in one month signals an abrupt monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS decrease above 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only when accompanied by low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 260).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1.2-year rolling window during low-inflation periods with PAYEMS above 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of retail sales (RSAFS) above 525,000 signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 45% of instances with RSAFS above 525,000.
